name: lop-hoc-dieu-ky
description: Lớp Học Diệu Kỳ — trường học online 2D (modular monolith, npm workspaces).

scripts.check: npm run check -w @lhdk/domain && npm run check:classroom && npm run check:world
scripts.check:classroom: npm run validate -w @lhdk/classroom && npm run typecheck -w @lhdk/classroom && npm test -w @lhdk/classroom && npm run build -w @lhdk/classroom
scripts.check:world: npm run check -w @lhdk/server && npm run check -w @lhdk/campus
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:classroom && npm run test:e2e:campus
